title: Updating an embedded tape
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ work-tape indices into the $k$ work-tape indices, let $c$ be a configuration on the smaller machine, and let $i$ be one of its tape indices. For any larger-tape background contents and head positions, updating tape $i$ of $c$ to a content function $f$ before embedding gives the same configuration as first embedding $c$ and then updating the embedded tape $\iota(i)$ to $f$.
